newsitem.title: UK: Chiroscience sees two drugs moving to phase1.
newsitem.headline: Chiroscience sees two drugs moving to phase1.

text.p: British drug research firm Chiroscience Group Plc said on Wednesday that it expects two drugs used against cancer, both of them matrix metalloproteinase inhibitors, to move to Phase 1 clinical studies later this year.
The company's metalloproteinase inhibitor for arthritis started its second Phase 1 clinical trial this week.

Chairman Lord Chilver told shareholders at the company's annual meeting that the firm expected to make its first marketing authorisation application for Levobupivacaine in Europe before the end of this year.
It also anticipates making its first new drug application for the anaesthetic Levobupivacaine during April 1998.
